//: Every KoleksiAdmin value is supplied per environment, by the Koleksi-Admin-<stage> CDK stack, as
KOLEKSIADMIN__SECTION__KEY environment variables. They are blank here on purpose:
KoleksiAdminOptions.Validate() fails startup on a blank value, so a deployment that forgets one crashes
on the first cold start rather than serving staff with, say, an unset token issuer. See docs/configuration.md.
